name: Tomari Erina
source:
Race: Dark Elf

A dark elf that resides in the apartment where the protagonist stays at as his neighbor.

A cool, beautiful young woman whose stoic face makes it difficult for others to interact with her. The person in question believes it is "because I am a dark elf" and has a complex about it.

As an older dark elf, there are many things in the world she is ignorant off. She has a habit of pointing out things and getting embarrassed about it later.

An honors student who is the student council president and the protagonist's reliable senior.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=992134]Getchu[/url]]
